headline: **MLB Daily Recap: Guardians, Rays, and Marlins Shine**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a convincing 8-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, led by José Ramírez's impressive performance at the plate. Ramírez hit 3 hits, including his 8th home run of the season. In other action, the Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Baltimore Orioles 16-6, with Junior Caminero leading the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs. The Miami Marlins also had a strong day, routing the Atlanta Braves 12-0 behind Javier Sanoja's home run and four RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. The Colorado Rockies placed left fielder Jordan Beck on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. The Los Angeles Dodgers transferred right-handed pitcher Ben Casparius from the 15-day to the 60-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. Other teams have also suffered injuries, including the Texas Rangers, Atlanta Braves, Houston Astros, Tampa Bay Rays, Kansas City Royals, and New York Mets.

The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays for cash considerations. The Chicago White Sox acquired center fielder Junior Perez from the Athletics in exchange for left-handed pitcher Jackson Nove. The Athletics also traded right-handed pitcher Kyle Robinson to the Pittsburgh Pirates for second baseman Alika Williams and traded right-handed pitcher Eduarniel Núñez to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Tigers 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured an 8-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, led by José Ramírez's impressive performance at the plate. Ramírez hit 3 hits, including his 8th home run of the season, a fly ball to left field.

top_news.title: **Rays Rout Orioles 16-6**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Baltimore Orioles in a lopsided 16-6 victory. Junior Caminero led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall Short in Philly**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dropped a 4-5 decision to the Philadelphia Phillies, marking their loss in the matchup. Bryson Stott led the Phillies' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Rout Braves 12-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Atlanta Braves in a one-sided contest, securing a 12-0 victory. Javier Sanoja led the Marlins' offense with a home run and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Jordan Beck on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left fielder Jordan Beck has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. The injury occurred on May 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Lauer Joins Dodgers Roster**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays. The trade was reportedly made for cash considerations.
